messages.subject: Reservoir calibration
parts:
Hello Tam,
I hope you're doing well. I'm trying to calibrate the SWAT+ nitrate model in a reservoir. I want to optimize the flo_stor (column 12)/ no3_stor (column 16) from the reservoir_day.txt file. Is there any way to achieve this using RSWAT?

Thanks,
Mahesh

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Reservoir calibration
parts:
Hi Mahesh,

sorry with SWAT+ only possible to calibrate for parameters that are listed in the  cal_parms.cal files.

Cheers,
Tam

messages.author: e28329d3e25e358e
messages.subject: Re: Reservoir calibration
parts:
HI Mahesh,
1) Just copy this file and replace the same file in ./R/userReadSwatOutput.R
2) In step 3. Run SWAT => Define model outputs for extraction just add one more line as shown in this figure https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wiki/tamnva/R-SWAT/Figures/userReadSwatOutput/Fig_13.png
3) Your observed data MUST have the same starting and ending dates as in the reservoir_day.txt file (if you don't have data, just put as NA)
